stem: Which sentence from the story “How Six Sons Rescued Anansi” best helps the reader understand that Anansi’s problem is resolved?
instruction: Use “How Six Sons Rescued Anansi” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: Seconds later a huge bubble floated out with Anansi screaming for help inside it! (paragraph 9)

options.label: H
options.text: Anansi plunged from the sky back toward the earth. (paragraph 12)

options.label: J
options.text: Anansi landed with a gentle bounce on Puffy Pillow’s soft, springy back. (paragraph 15)
